UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile, studio preferences, staff invisible toggle, timed suspension, capability restrictions, and personal blocklist.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in chat rooms (1-40 chars).

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG Base64 profile picture (0-120000 chars).

nightModeEnabled.description: Optional Night Blue dark theme toggle (false = default Blue & White theme).

invisibleModePreferred.description: Admin or authorized Support preference to enter rooms invisibly.

disableVideo.description: Admin-controlled restriction disabling camera video broadcast.

disableMessaging.description: Staff/Admin-controlled restriction disabling room chat and DM messaging.

lastDeviceId.description: Hashed app-scoped device identifier used to enforce device-level bans across alternate emails.

addPeopleTimestamps.description: Sliding 10-minute epoch ms timestamps enforcing max 25 people added per 10 minutes.

spamViolationTimestamps.description: Sliding 24-hour epoch ms timestamps tracking automated message spam violations (>20 msgs in 30s).

suspendedUntilMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds until which the user is suspended by Admin or Support (0 = not suspended).

suspensionReason.description: Optional reason shown to suspended user (0-200 chars).

pointsBalance.description: Available spendable in-app points balance (1 point = $1; includes purchased points, creator earned points, streak rollovers, and referral bonuses).

halfPointsBalance.description: Half-point remainder (0 or 1, representing +0.5 pt from free-user 7-day login streaks; two halves merge into +1 full point).

creatorEarnedPoints.description: Cumulative spendable in-app points earned as a creator (+1 pt per 2-pt photo unlock, +1 pt per $5 paid DM unlock, +8 pts per creator subscription). Credited directly to pointsBalance; app owner earns 100% of money.

creatorEarningsCents.description: Legacy deprecated counter retained for backward compatibility. App owner earns 100% of money; creators earn spendable in-app points in pointsBalance / creatorEarnedPoints.

proMember.description: Whether the user has an active VOX Pro ($9.99/mo), VIP Pro ($29.99/mo), or Elite Pro ($59.99/mo) membership.

proTier.description: Active membership tier determining Group DM max members: FREE (7), PRO (15), VIP_PRO (25), ELITE_PRO (50).

proExpiresAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when Pro membership expires (0 = not Pro).

proLifetime.description: Admin-granted Lifetime Pro status that never expires or requires renewal.

profileViewersUnlockedUntilMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds until which a free user has unlocked the full Who Viewed My Profile list (2 points per 24h unlock).

priorityChirpOptIn.description: Whether the user opts in to allow close friends to send 1-2 point Priority Break-In Chirps.

profileBoostedUntilMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds until which this user's profile is promoted to the top of Discovery People (5 points per 24h boost).

spotlightFrameUntilMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds until which a glowing neon Spotlight Frame border appears around this user's avatar in Discover and Chats (5 points per 24h).

spotlightFrameColorHex.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) of the user's active 24-hour glowing neon Spotlight Frame.

loginStreakDays.description: Current consecutive UTC days the user has logged into VoxStage.

lastLoginDayKey.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the user's most recent daily login check-in.

lastStreakRewardDayKey.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the user last received a free-member 7-day +0.5 pt login streak reward.

referredByUserId.description: UID of the inviter whose referral code this user redeemed (set once).

referralBonusClaimed.description: Whether this invited user has completed account verification + first PTT clip and claimed the +2 pt bonus for both users.

referralEarnedPoints.description: Cumulative usable points earned from inviting friends (+2 pts per completed referral).

ownedPttThemes.description: List of purchased custom floating PTT button theme IDs.

selectedPttTheme.description: Currently equipped floating PTT button color/glow ring theme.

ownedPttChirps.description: List of purchased custom walkie-talkie chirp sound IDs.

selectedPttChirp.description: Currently equipped PTT key-down/key-up radio chirp tone.

totalSpentCents.description: Total USD cents spent on points, Pro membership, paid DMs, and creator subscriptions.

dmPolicy.description: Private message privacy setting: OPEN (anyone), PAID ($5 lock — full $5 goes to app owner and recipient earns +1 usable in-app point), or DISABLED (no private messages).

adultVerified.description: Whether the user has verified they are 18+ years old (required to lock photos or view/unlock locked photos).

birthYear.description: User's self-verified birth year (0 if unverified; must satisfy age >= 18 when adultVerified is true).

sex.description: Optional user sex/gender for Discovery filtering.

age.description: Optional user age (0 if unset, or 18-120) for Discovery filtering.

totalTimeSpentSec.description: Cumulative foreground time spent on the app in seconds.

appearanceStatus.description: User-selected visible status (Admins and Support always see true live status).

blockedUserIds.description: Bounded list of up to 100 blocked UIDs.

pictureUploadTimestamps.description: Sliding-window epoch ms timestamps (max 10) enforcing max 10 picture uploads per 10 minutes.

discoveryPhotoTimestamps.description: Sliding-window epoch ms timestamps (max 2) enforcing max 2 Discovery photo posts per 7-day week for free members.

customDisplayName.description: Admin-only optional custom display name disguise (0-40 chars).

customNameColorHex.description: Admin-only optional custom username hex color (#RRGGBB).

companySubAccount.description: True when this account is a VIP Pro company employee sub-account (no perks except PTT & 60s clips, locked to company DM).

parentCompanyOwnerId.description: UID of the VIP Pro company owner for a company sub-account.

companyName.description: Company workspace display name for a company sub-account.

companyThreadId.description: Private Group DM thread ID that a company sub-account is restricted to.

subAccountId.description: Document ID in companySubAccounts claimed by this employee.

doNotDisturb.description: Do Not Disturb toggle silencing non-urgent alerts while allowing urgent alerts to break through.

StaffRole.title: StaffRole
StaffRole.description: Authoritative Admin and Support Staff assignments keyed by user UID, including per-member invisible permission.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

canEnterInvisible.description: Whether Admin allows this Support member to enter rooms invisibly (always true for ADMIN).

addedByUid.description: UID of administrator who assigned the role.

inviteId.description: Optional staffInvites document ID when claimed via email invite.

StaffInvite.title: StaffInvite
StaffInvite.description: Email-based Support Staff invitation created by an Admin.

email.description: Lowercase Google email of invited Support staff.

displayName.description: Label/name for the invited staff member.

canEnterInvisible.description: Whether this Support invite grants invisible room entry permission.

UserAlert.title: UserAlert
UserAlert.description: Direct real-time alert sent by Admin or Support to a user, editable by Admin.

targetName.description: Display name of the recipient user.

senderId.description: UID of sending Admin or Support staff.

acknowledged.description: Whether recipient has acknowledged the alert.

ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: Live voice, video, and text chat room with integrated moderation settings.

adminMicPriorityActive.description: True while App Owner Administrator holds exclusive microphone override in this room.

bannedNamesByUserId.description: Map of banned userId -> displayName visible to Room Admins.

bouncedUntilByUserId.description: Map of userId -> epoch millis until which a bounced user is locked out of entering the room (24h).

bouncedNamesByUserId.description: Map of bounced userId -> displayName visible in the Room Admin Bounce List.

pinLocked.description: Whether the room requires a 4-digit numeric PIN code to enter.

roomPinCode.description: 4-digit numeric PIN code required to enter when pinLocked is true.

RoomParticipant.title: RoomParticipant
RoomParticipant.description: Live stage/listener presence, staff tier color, invisible flag, and media status.

enteredPin.description: Optional 4-digit PIN verified on room join when room.pinLocked is true.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Real-time text chat message with staff tier color indicator.

reactionsByEmoji.description: Map of emoji string to array of reacting user UIDs stored in Firestore.

ModerationLog.title: ModerationLog
ModerationLog.description: Immutable room moderation audit trail entry.

SafetyReport.title: SafetyReport
SafetyReport.description: User-submitted safety incident report scoped to reporter, room host, and admins.

DirectoryEntry.title: DirectoryEntry
DirectoryEntry.description: Public user discovery profile for browsing users, viewing profiles, finding friends, and starting private messages.

proMember.description: Whether the user has an active VOX Pro, VIP Pro, or Elite Pro membership (displays Blue username).

proTier.description: Public membership tier for Group DM capacity checks (FREE=7, PRO=15, VIP_PRO=25, ELITE_PRO=50).

proExpiresAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when Pro membership expires.

proLifetime.description: Admin-granted Lifetime Pro status that never expires.

priorityChirpOptIn.description: Whether this user opts in to receive Priority Break-In Chirps from close friends.

profileBoostedUntilMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds until which this profile is promoted to the top of Discovery People.

spotlightFrameUntilMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds until which a glowing neon Spotlight Frame border appears around this user's avatar in Discover and Chats.

spotlightFrameColorHex.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) for the user's active glowing neon Spotlight Frame.

referralCode.description: Public shareable Invite-a-Friend code for referral lookup.

appearanceStatus.description: User-selected visible status (Admins/Support see true online status).

totalTimeSpentSec.description: Cumulative seconds spent on the app.

acceptedFriendIds.description: Bounded list of accepted friend UIDs (max 200) used to compute Friends-of-Friends suggestions.

customDisplayName.description: Admin-only optional custom display name disguise.

customNameColorHex.description: Admin-only optional custom username hex color (#RRGGBB).

companySubAccount.description: True when this user is a company employee sub-account.

parentCompanyOwnerId.description: Owner UID for a company employee sub-account.

doNotDisturb.description: Do Not Disturb status visible to team supervisors.

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: Two-way friendship or pending friend request keyed deterministically by sorted UIDs.

userIds.description: Exactly 2 UIDs [requesterId, recipientId] for array-contains queries.

DirectThread.title: DirectThread
DirectThread.description: Private 1-on-1 or multi-user group message thread supporting live calls, camera snaps, and paid-DM kick enforcement.

participantIds.description: 2 to 50 participant UIDs (Free max 7, Pro max 15, VIP Pro max 25, Elite Pro max 50).

isGroup.description: True when 3+ users or created as a group chat.

groupName.description: Optional display name for a group private chat.

groupAdminId.description: UID of the Group DM creator/administrator who can mute, bounce, ban, appoint Group Support Staff, assign PTT speakers (>15 users), and talk over anyone.

groupAdminTalking.description: True while the Group DM Administrator holds priority talk-over mic access.

groupSupportIds.description: UIDs appointed by the Group DM Administrator as Group DM Support Staff (can mute and 24h bounce regular members).

companyOwnerId.description: UID of the VIP Pro company owner when this Group DM is a Company Workspace thread.

groupSupervisorIds.description: UIDs appointed by the Company Owner as Group DM Supervisors (admins who can moderate and send work orders/notes).

pttAllowedUserIds.description: UIDs authorized by the Group DM Administrator to use Push-to-Talk when the group has more than 15 members.

participantNamesById.description: Map of UID to display name for group chat participants.

kickedUserIds.description: UIDs kicked from sending messages in this thread.

blockedByUserIds.description: UIDs of participants who have blocked the other participant in this 1-on-1 thread.

pttEnabledUserIds.description: Participant UIDs who enabled Live Push-to-Talk on this thread.

disappearingDurationSec.description: Disappearing message timer in seconds (0 = off, 30, 300, 3600, or 86400).

readReceiptsDisabledByUserIds.description: Participant UIDs who disabled read receipts for this thread.

readTimestampsByUserId.description: Map of participant UID to epoch ms when they last read this thread.

lastAlertSenderId.description: UID of friend who last sent a ring & vibrate attention alert.

lastAlertSenderName.description: Display name of friend who last sent an attention alert.

lastAlertAtMillis.description: Epoch ms of the last attention alert (enforces 1 alert per 5 minutes).

pinnedMessageId.description: ID of the currently pinned message in this private chat (empty if none).

pinnedMessageText.description: Preview text of the currently pinned message (up to 300 chars).

pinnedMessageSenderName.description: Display name of the sender of the pinned message.

pinnedByUserId.description: UID of the participant who pinned the message.

pinnedByName.description: Display name of the participant who pinned the message.

pinnedAtMillis.description: Epoch ms when the message was pinned (0 if none).

talkStreakCount.description: Consecutive UTC days both participants exchanged at least one DM or PTT clip (displayed with flame/radio-tower icon at 3+ days).

talkStreakLastMutualDay.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) when both participants last exchanged a message or PTT clip.

lastMessageDayByUserId.description: Map of participant UID to most recent UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) they sent a message or PTT clip in this thread.

priorityChirpOptInUserIds.description: Participant UIDs who opted in to receive Priority Break-In Chirps in this DM.

lastPriorityChirpAtMillis.description: Epoch ms of the most recent Priority Break-In Chirp sent in this thread.

lastPriorityChirpSenderId.description: UID of the sender of the most recent Priority Break-In Chirp.

lastPriorityChirpSenderName.description: Display name of the sender of the most recent Priority Break-In Chirp.

lastPriorityChirpMessage.description: Short alert text accompanying the Priority Break-In Chirp.

lastPriorityChirpPoints.description: Points spent on the Priority Break-In Chirp (1 = Priority, 2 = Urgent Break-In).

lastPriorityChirpAcknowledgedBy.description: Participant UIDs who have opened/acknowledged the latest Priority Break-In Chirp.

bannerText.description: Active 24-hour scrolling banner text displayed near the top of the DM (1 point).

bannerAuthorId.description: UID of the user who purchased the active DM scrolling banner.

bannerAuthorName.description: Display name of the user who purchased the active DM scrolling banner.

bannerColorHex.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) of the active DM scrolling banner.

bannerExpiresAtMillis.description: Epoch ms when the active 24-hour DM scrolling banner expires.

DirectMessage.title: DirectMessage
DirectMessage.description: Immutable 1-on-1 private message (text and/or camera snap photo) inside a DirectThread.

audioBase64.description: Optional compressed M4A/AAC voice note encoded as Base64.

audioDurationSec.description: Duration of the attached voice note in seconds (0-60).

expiresAtMillis.description: Optional epoch ms when a disappearing message expires (0 = permanent).

messageType.description: Optional message type for normal text/media, screenshot alert notices, admin-to-support handoffs, or Priority Break-In Chirps.

reactionsByUserId.description: Map of participant UID to emoji reaction ('❤️', '👍', '😂', '😮', '😢', '🔥').

ProfilePost.title: ProfilePost
ProfilePost.description: User-authored profile update containing text, an optional compressed JPEG photo (optionally locked for 2 points / $2), optional 5-point ($5) Discovery top-pin boost, and community likes.

locked.description: Whether the attached photo is locked (requires 2 points / $2 or $15/mo creator subscription).

unlockPricePoints.description: Points required to unlock this locked photo (fixed at 2).

unlockedByUserIds.description: UIDs that unlocked this photo individually.

boostedAtMillis.description: Epoch ms when the author last paid 5 points ($5) to boost this post to the top of Discovery.

boostedUntilMillis.description: Epoch ms until which this post stays pinned at the top of Discovery (24 hours per 5-point boost).

commentCount.description: Total number of comments on this post.

shareCount.description: Number of times this unlocked post has been shared.

sharedFromPostId.description: Original unlocked post ID if this post is an in-app share/repost.

PostComment.title: PostComment
PostComment.description: User comment on a profile post or picture.

CreatorSubscription.title: CreatorSubscription
CreatorSubscription.description: Monthly $15 creator subscription unlocking all locked photos from a specific creator for 30 days.

DmAccessPass.title: DmAccessPass
DmAccessPass.description: Paid $5 private message access pass (full $5 to app owner; recipient earns +1 usable in-app point) that can be revoked/kicked by the recipient.

PointTransaction.title: PointTransaction
PointTransaction.description: Immutable ledger entry recording point purchases, Pro memberships ($9.99/mo or 10 pts), 2-point photo unlocks (creator earns +1 usable pt), 5-point Picture/Reel/Profile boosts, custom PTT themes & chirps, $5 paid DMs (full $5 to app owner; recipient earns +1 usable pt), and $15/mo creator subscriptions (full $15 to app owner; creator earns +8 usable pts).

playOrderId.description: Optional verified Google Play Billing order ID for BUY_POINTS purchases.

playProductId.description: Optional Google Play Billing product SKU ID for BUY_POINTS purchases.

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Global Admin-managed configuration including the Login Screen news/updates banner and 1-day trial login toggle.

bannerTitle.description: Banner headline shown on the main login screen (0-80 chars).

bannerMessage.description: Updates or news body shown on the main login screen (0-400 chars).

bannerEnabled.description: Whether the news/updates banner is visible on the login screen.

trialLoginsEnabled.description: Whether 1-day trial logins are permitted by the administrator.

updatedByName.description: Display name of the administrator who last updated config.

RoomTransfer.title: RoomTransfer
RoomTransfer.description: Admin-initiated real-time directive sending a specific user to another live room.

userId.description: Target user UID matching document ID.

movedByAdminId.description: UID of the administrator who sent the user.

reason.description: Optional reason shown to the user.

transferType.description: Whether the Admin directive routes the user to a live room or a Support member's private chat.

targetThreadId.description: Destination private message thread ID when transferType is SUPPORT_DM.

targetSupportUserId.description: Target Support member UID when transferType is SUPPORT_DM.

targetSupportName.description: Target Support member display name when transferType is SUPPORT_DM.

consumed.description: Set to true by the recipient client once navigated.

SupportTicket.title: SupportTicket
SupportTicket.description: User-submitted support ticket visible to the requester and all Admin/Support staff.

requesterId.description: UID of the user who opened the ticket.

details.description: Detailed description of the issue (4-1000 chars).

assignedStaffId.description: Optional UID of the targeted or responding Admin/Support member.

assignedStaffName.description: Optional display name of the targeted or responding Admin/Support member.

staffResponse.description: Reply note from Admin or Support staff.

UserFollow.title: UserFollow
UserFollow.description: Directed follow edge (followerId -> followingId) powering live Followers and Following counts on user profiles.

followerId.description: UID of the user who follows.

followingId.description: UID of the user being followed.

AppBroadcast.title: AppBroadcast
AppBroadcast.description: Admin-sent app-wide announcement message delivered in real time to all signed-in users.

senderId.description: UID of the Admin who sent the broadcast.

senderName.description: Display name of the Admin who sent the broadcast.

Reel.title: Reel
Reel.description: Vertical short video reel (max 30 seconds, Pro-only upload) with $5 boost-to-top, likes, comments, and shares.

chunkCount.description: Number of Base64 video chunks stored in /reels/{reelId}/chunks (1-16).

ReelChunk.title: ReelChunk
ReelChunk.description: Ordered Base64-encoded video segment belonging to a parent Reel.

ReelComment.title: ReelComment
ReelComment.description: Community comment on a vertical video Reel.

ReferralRecord.title: ReferralRecord
ReferralRecord.description: Invite-a-Friend referral link keyed by invitee UID awarding +2 points to both inviter and invitee once the invitee verifies their account and sends their first PTT clip.

ProfileViewRecord.title: ProfileViewRecord
ProfileViewRecord.description: Records when a user visits another user's profile to power Who Viewed My Profile teaser & unlocked viewer list.

UserModerationFile.title: UserModerationFile
UserModerationFile.description: Automated 5-strike safety report escalation file tracking report count, active investigation, warnings, timed suspensions (1h on 3rd, 2h on 4th), and indefinite suspension pending Support/Admin resolution on 5th+ report.

pendingAdminReview.description: True when Support staff requested suspension and the user is suspended until an Admin reviews.

UserFileNote.title: UserFileNote
UserFileNote.description: Append-only moderation file note logged for every safety report (strikes 1-5+) and staff investigation resolution, readable only by Support and Admin.

ReportRateLimit.title: ReportRateLimit
ReportRateLimit.description: Rolling 1-hour report rate limiter per user (max 3 different targets, 1 report per target per hour).

SuspensionRequest.title: SuspensionRequest
SuspensionRequest.description: Support-submitted suspension request with mandatory reason that immediately suspends the user until reviewed by an Admin.

RefundReport.title: RefundReport
RefundReport.description: Record-keeping report for every membership or purchase refund issued by an App Admin or Support Staff member.

PerkGrant.title: PerkGrant
PerkGrant.description: Audit record of any app perk granted to a user by App Admin or Support Staff, tracked for the 30-perks-in-5-days Support Staff alert.

AdminNotification.title: AdminNotification
AdminNotification.description: Real-time record-keeping and threshold notifications delivered to App Admins (Support refunds and Support 30-perks-in-5-days alerts).

CompanySubAccount.title: CompanySubAccount
CompanySubAccount.description: VIP Pro company employee sub-name credential bound to the owner's private Company Group DM.

WorkOrder.title: WorkOrder
WorkOrder.description: Work task or note sent by a Company Owner or Supervisor to an employee sub-account with Normal or Urgent priority.

EmployeeRequest.title: EmployeeRequest
EmployeeRequest.description: Request submitted by an employee sub-account to Company Owner and Supervisors.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles, preferences, DM privacy policy, timed suspensions, capability restrictions, and blocklists.

/userDirectory/{userId}.description: Minimal public user directory for friend search, Discovery, and direct messaging.

/friendships/{friendshipId}.description: Pending friend requests and accepted two-way friendships.

/directThreads/{threadId}.description: Private 1-on-1 and group chat threads displayed on the Chats home screen.

/directThreads/{threadId}/messages/{mess.description: Private messages scoped strictly to thread participants.

/dmAccessPasses/{passId}.description: Paid $10 private message passes ($5 user / $5 app owner) with kick/revoke support.

/staffRoles/{userId}.description: Authoritative Admin and Support Staff role registry with per-member invisible permission.

/staffInvites/{inviteId}.description: Email-based Support Staff invitations managed by Admins.

/userAlerts/{alertId}.description: Direct real-time safety alerts sent by Admins or Support Staff and editable by Admins.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Live voice, video, and text chat rooms.

/rooms/{roomId}/participants/{participan.description: Active participants, stage roles, staff color tiers, and stealth presence.

/rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time text chat messages, reactions, and moderation notices.

/safetyReports/{reportId}.description: Safety incident reports visible to reporter, room host, and admins.

/profilePosts/{postId}.description: Public profile posts (text and/or photos, including 2-point locked photos, 5-point Discovery boosts, likes, comments, and unlocked shares).

/profilePosts/{postId}/comments/{comment.description: Community comments on profile posts and pictures.

/creatorSubscriptions/{subId}.description: Active $15/month creator subscriptions unlocking all locked photos for a creator.

/pointTransactions/{txId}.description: Append-only ledger tracking Google Play point purchases, 2-pt photo unlocks ($1/$1), 5-pt Discovery boosts ($5), $10 paid DMs ($5/$5), and $15/mo subscriptions ($7.50/$7.50).

/appConfig/{configId}.description: Singleton global app config ('global') controlling login screen news/updates banner and trial login toggle.

/roomTransfers/{userId}.description: Admin-issued live room transfer directives automatically moving a target user into a different room.

/supportTickets/{ticketId}.description: User support tickets managed by Admin and Support staff.

/userFollows/{followId}.description: Directed follower -> following edges keyed by {followerId}__{followingId}.

/appBroadcasts/{broadcastId}.description: Admin-authored app-wide broadcast messages delivered live to all signed-in users.

/reels/{reelId}.description: Vertical swipe video reels (max 30s, Pro-only upload) with $5 boost to top, likes, comments, and shares.

/reels/{reelId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Ordered Base64 MP4 video chunks for a parent Reel.

/reels/{reelId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Community comments on a vertical video Reel.

/referrals/{inviteeId}.description: Invite-a-Friend referral records granting +2 points to both inviter and new user once verified and first PTT clip is sent.

/profileViews/{viewId}.description: Profile visit records keyed by {targetUserId}_{viewerId} powering Who Viewed My Profile.

/userModerationFiles/{userId}.description: Automated 5-strike report escalation state and investigation status per user.

/userModerationFiles/{userId}/notes/{not.description: Private append-only moderation file notes per user readable only by Support and Admin.

/reportRateLimits/{userId}.description: Rolling 1-hour per-user report rate limiter (max 3 different target users, 1 report each per hour).

/suspensionRequests/{requestId}.description: Support-submitted suspension requests with mandatory reasons pending Admin review.

/refundReports/{reportId}.description: Refund audit reports issued by Admins and Support Staff (Support refunds also notify App Admins).

/perkGrants/{grantId}.description: App perk grant log used by Admins and Support Staff and monitored for the 30-perks-in-5-days Support threshold.

/adminNotifications/{notifId}.description: Admin-only record-keeping and threshold notifications from Support Staff actions.

/bannedDevices/{deviceHash}.description: Device-level ban records preventing banned users from logging in on the same device with another email.

/companySubAccounts/{subId}.description: Company employee sub-name slots created by VIP Pro/Elite Pro owners and claimed by employees.

/workOrders/{orderId}.description: Work orders and notes dispatched by Company Owners or Supervisors to employee sub-accounts.

/employeeRequests/{requestId}.description: Employee requests submitted by sub-accounts for Owner/Supervisor approval.
